mapper.select: SELECT id, username, nickname, avatar_asset_id FROM user_account WHERE id = #{userId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' LIMIT 1

SELECT u.id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar_asset_id FROM follow f INNER JOIN user_account u ON u.id = f.following_id AND u.status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE f.follower_id = #{followerId} ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
